title: Rough spectral asymptotics for commutators of general singular integrals
summary: Recently, Schatten class membership of commutators arising from Connes' quantised calculus has been characterised in a general framework, which covers multiple concrete situations of interest. In contrast to this, related results dealing with the asymptotic behaviour of the singular values of these commutators have been restricted to a relatively short list of specific examples only.
